# Yasin Engin

Yasin Engin - Computer Engineering Student | Network Automation, Future Networks & Go Distributed Systems

I build reproducible network automation labs, future-network research experiments, and Go-based distributed systems.

Computer Engineering student at Ondokuz Mayis University connecting Network Automation, Software-Defined Networking, NDN/ICN, DTN, LEO/NTN systems, Go backend systems, distributed systems, public technical education, and reproducible engineering practice.

## Canonical URL Policy

Directory-style project and collection URLs are canonical. Legacy URLs such as /projects.html, /videos.html, /library.html, and /projects/tolerex.html redirect to their canonical pages while preserving matching social preview metadata.
